title: The Beginning of Your New Relationship with God
description: A lesson focused on assurance of salvation and helping the disciple grow in a personal relationship with God.

cards.heading: Sharing Life Together
cards.scriptureText: Carry each other’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.
cards.body: Take time to share what happened during the past week. Be sensitive to the needs, struggles, and experiences of your disciple. This builds trust and strengthens your relationship.
cards.question: What is something important that happened to you this past week?

cards.heading: Reviewing God’s Promise
cards.scriptureText: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.
cards.body: Review the verse together and check if it has been memorized. This passage is key to understanding assurance of salvation.
cards.question: Can you explain what this verse means in your own words?

cards.heading: Understanding Assurance of Salvation
cards.scriptureText: Whoever has the Son has life; whoever does not have the Son of God does not have life.
cards.body: Use a simple illustration: eternal life is found in Jesus. If Jesus is in your life, then you have eternal life. Salvation is not based on feelings but on God’s promise.
cards.question: Do you believe that Jesus is in your life? How do you know?

cards.heading: Confidence in Your Salvation
cards.scriptureText: To all who did receive him... he gave the right to become children of God.
cards.body: A true believer knows they have received Christ by faith. Because of this, they have eternal life, not by works, but by God’s promise.
cards.question: What do you have now because Jesus is in your life?

cards.heading: What It Means to Be a Christian
cards.scriptureText: If anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come.
cards.body: A Christian is someone who believes in Jesus Christ and has accepted Him as Lord and Savior. This person now has a new life and eternal life in Him.
cards.question: How would you describe being a Christian to someone else?

cards.heading: God Cares for You Personally
cards.scriptureText: Even the very hairs of your head are all numbered.
cards.body: God deeply cares for you. If He cares for the birds, how much more for you as His child? He knows even the smallest details of your life.
cards.question: How does it make you feel knowing that God cares for you personally?

cards.heading: Growing Through God’s Word
cards.scriptureText: The beginning of the good news about Jesus the Messiah.
cards.body: Encourage your disciple to begin reading the Gospel of Mark. Ask about their progress, what they have learned, and if they have questions or difficulties in understanding.
cards.question: Have you started reading the Bible? What have you learned so far?

cards.heading: Prayer and Spiritual Growth
cards.scriptureText: In every situation, by prayer... present your requests to God.
cards.body: Share prayer requests with each other and pray together. Thank God and ask for the continued growth of your disciple in their relationship with Him.
cards.question: What is one thing you would like us to pray for today?

cards.heading: Next Steps
cards.scriptureText: Everything must be done so that the church may be built up.
cards.body: Set your next meeting and encourage your disciple to read and memorize the assigned verse. Continue building consistency in their spiritual life.
cards.question: What step will you take this week to grow in your relationship with God?
